posts.title: I wanted to learn more about my singing voice, so I built a tool to understand it better
posts.description: I play guitar and I record myself playing and singing, and a while back I hit a plateau. What kicked this off was Peter Gabriel's "In Your Eyes." I'd been listening to it and loving it, and then I tried it at karaoke and I just couldn't get it, which bugged me, because I can usually land other singers pretty close, both their notes and their style.
